name: e-invoicing-tr-invoice-type-codes
title: UBL-TR invoice type codes (e-Fatura)
description: The InvoiceTypeCode values used on Turkish e-invoices (e-Fatura and e-Arşiv Fatura), with their Turkish descriptions from the GİB code list, whether each code appears in the guide and in the UBL-TR schematron, and which codes are limited to Yatırım Teşvik e-Arşiv invoices.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.4 InvoiceTypeCode), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16

e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (InvoiceTypeCodeList, YatirimTesvikEArsivInvoiceTypeCodeList; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16: used for in_schematron and yatirim_tesvik_earchive

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish description paraphrased from section 1.4 of the guide (the guide is prose, not a table). Empty when the code is accepted by the schematron but not named in the guide.

fields.name: in_guide
fields.description: true when section 1.4 of Kod Listeleri names the code.

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when InvoiceTypeCodeList in the UBL-TR schematron accepts the code.

fields.name: yatirim_tesvik_earchive
fields.description: true when YatirimTesvikEArsivInvoiceTypeCodeList also lists the code (YTBSATIS, YTBIADE, YTBISTISNA, YTBTEVKIFAT, YTBTEVKIFATIADE).
